decisions.label: Gera
decisions.gloss_en: Gera (town; seat of the Landrathsbezirk Gera)

decisions.label: Hirschberg
decisions.note: Hirschberg an der Saale (Schloss, former Herrschaft/Pflege Hirschberg); not Hirschberg in Silesia.

decisions.label: Ebersdorf
decisions.note: Ebersdorf near Lobenstein (also called Heiligen-Ebersdorf, Herrnhuter Colonie, summer residence of the prince); one of many places named Ebersdorf.

decisions.label: Köstritz
decisions.note: Residence of the Paragiat line Reuß-Köstritz; "fast städtisches" large village.

decisions.label: Greiz
decisions.note: Residence of the Reuss elder line (Reuß ä. L.), outside the principality.

decisions.label: Kulm
decisions.note: Kulm near Saalburg (register p. 675). Homonym: Culm in the Bramthal near Zschippach (Landrathsbezirk Gera, p. 546), see key Culm.

decisions.label: Altenburg
decisions.note: City of Altenburg, but often the Duchy of Saxe-Altenburg (cf. Herzogthum S.-Altenburg).

decisions.label: Hof
decisions.note: Hof in Bavaria (Upper Franconia).

decisions.label: Gefell
decisions.note: Prussian territory (Gefell parish, Kr. Ziegenrück), adjoining the principality; the churches of Blintendorf, Frössen etc. were parished to Gefell until 1869.

decisions.label: Burgk
decisions.note: Burgk on the Saale (Schloss; historically Herrschaft/Haus Burgk). No article in Brückner's Ortskunde.

decisions.label: Dittersdorf
decisions.note: Dittersdorf near Schleiz (p. 614). Two Wüstungen of this name: near Schleiz (p. 593) and near Tanna (p. 689).

decisions.label: Arlas
decisions.note: Former pilgrimage place with chapel ruin (Feldkirche); on the border between Reuss and Prussia, two of the four houses on Reuss soil.

decisions.label: Kießling
decisions.note: Political municipality made up of several groups (Abfang, Bärwinkel, Buttermühle etc.).

decisions.label: Kretschwitz
decisions.note: Brückner's register and article spell Kretschwitz; the text also has Kretzschwitz, Cretzschwitz.

decisions.label: Hermsdorf
decisions.note: Hermsdorf in the Gera district near the Prussian border (p. 530), not Hermsdorf near Eisenberg.

decisions.label: Göritz
decisions.note: Göritz near Hirschberg (Lobenstein-Ebersdorf).

decisions.label: Kranichfeld
decisions.note: Herrschaft Kranichfeld, part of the Reuss princes' title; not part of the principality.

decisions.label: Cuba
decisions.note: Cuba near Gera, in the Elster valley.

decisions.label: Cronswitz
decisions.note: Dominican convent Cronschwitz (near Weida), founded by Jutta of Reuss; occasionally the village. Not in the principality.

decisions.label: Culm
decisions.note: Culm in the Bramthal near Zschippach (Landrathsbezirk Gera, p. 546); not Kulm near Saalburg (p. 675, see key Kulm).

decisions.label: Gottliebsthal
decisions.note: Group of 12 houses at the mouth of the Rattenbach into the Saale, in the Gemeinde Saaldorf; formerly also Gottliebshammer or Friesenthal.

decisions.label: Eisenberg
decisions.note: Eisenberg in the Duchy of Saxe-Altenburg.

decisions.label: Blankenberg
decisions.note: "Das preußische Blankenberg": Prussian territory on the Saale, bordering the principality.

decisions.label: Berg
decisions.note: Berg near Hof (Bavaria); parish church of Pottiga and Sparnberg.

decisions.label: Friesau
decisions.note: Village in the "greizer Oberland" (Reuss ä. L.), formerly belonging to Lobenstein; the Friesa brook flows through it.

decisions.label: Hornsgrün
decisions.note: Inn with four outbuildings in the Gemeinde Neundorf, built by a forester Horn in the 18th century.

decisions.label: Heinrichshall
decisions.note: Recent brine/gypsum works with chemical factory between Pohlitz and Langenberg near the Köstritz station.

decisions.label: Haueisen
decisions.note: Crown estate with 15 private houses, on the Saale below Saaldorf.

decisions.label: Bellevue
decisions.note: Temple-shaped pleasure house (1783) on the Schönbrunn-Ebersdorf road.

decisions.label: Dürrenbach
decisions.note: Youngest municipality of the principality (1869), formed from Dürrenbach, Pröstrich, Heinrichsort and Schweinshüter.

decisions.label: Dürrenberg
decisions.note: Former Rittergut, now a Köstritz Vorwerk south of Köstritz; not Bad Dürrenberg.

decisions.reason: common noun Hain (grove) and field names (Hain at Osterstein, Hain in Flur); the one village Hain (greizer Ort) is not separable

decisions.label: Eger
decisions.note: Town and district of Eger in Bohemia (Cheb); a few mentions refer to the river Eger.

decisions.label: Bamberg
decisions.note: City and bishopric of Bamberg.

decisions.label: Dölau
decisions.note: Residence of the Reuss line Dölau near Greiz (outside the principality).

decisions.label: Falke
decisions.note: The two united estates Kleinfalke and Wüstfalke (Falke), Landrathsbezirk Gera exclave; see Kleinfalke.

decisions.label: Auma
decisions.note: Town in Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach.

decisions.label: Corbußen
decisions.note: Village north of Groitschen on the Altenburg side; no article in Brückner's Ortskunde.

decisions.label: Brückla
decisions.note: One of the "greizer Orte" (Reuss ä. L.).

decisions.label: Heinrichsruhe
decisions.note: Princely country seat with extensive forest park near Schleiz (created by Heinrich XLII.), outside the municipal association.

decisions.label: Heinrichsgrün
decisions.note: Princely crown estate and forester's seat in the Gemeinde Neundorf (Lobenstein), "neues Fuhrwerk".

decisions.label: Jägersruh
decisions.note: Former hermitage, now a princely hunting lodge in the Frankenwald, outside the municipal association.

decisions.label: Karolinenfield
decisions.note: Forest crown-estate settlement ("Waldhaus", "schleizer Waldhaus"); variant spellings Karolinenfeld, Carolinenfeld.

decisions.label: Hauenstein
decisions.note: Burg Hauenstein in Bohemia, seat of the Lords of Weida "zu Hauenstein".

decisions.label: Gries
decisions.note: Quarter of Untermhaus (Gera), around the Reichsburg Osterstein.

decisions.label: Benignengrün
decisions.note: "Stiehlers- oder oberer Hammer" at the confluence of the Oßla and another brook, in the Gemeinde Wurzbach.

decisions.label: Eleonorenthal
decisions.note: Former pleasure resort, now an isolated group of houses WSW of Köstritz.

decisions.label: Hohendorf
decisions.note: Deserted settlement between Pöritzsch, Saalburg, Röppisch and Zoppothen (article of Ebersdorf).

decisions.label: Großenstein
decisions.note: Village in the Duchy of Saxe-Altenburg.

decisions.label: Fürstenthum Reuß jüngerer Linie
decisions.note: The state the book is about; also called "das Fürstenthum".

decisions.label: Heidefeld
decisions.note: Hamlet founded about 1796, in the Gemeinde Gebersreuth.

decisions.label: Heinrichsort
decisions.note: Two-storey single house in the forest between Vogelbach and Dürrenbach (Gemeinde Dürrenbach).

decisions.label: Asch
decisions.note: Asch in Bohemia (Aš).

decisions.label: Grobsdorf
decisions.note: Village east of the Elster (Saxe-Altenburg), opposite Geißen.

decisions.label: Elsterberg
decisions.note: Town in the Saxon Vogtland.

decisions.label: Koskau
decisions.note: Collective name for the two villages Unterkoskau (p. 698) and Oberkoskau (p. 699).

decisions.label: Berga
decisions.note: Berga an der Elster (Saxe-Weimar).

decisions.label: Dobene
decisions.note: Medieval Gau Dobene (Dobenowe) in the Elster area, named beside the Gau Gera.

decisions.label: Königswart
decisions.note: Bohemian Herrschaft (Königswart) in a list of possessions of the Vögte of Plauen.

decisions.label: Gernrode
decisions.note: Convent (Stift) Gernrode in the Harz.

decisions.label: Herrnhut
decisions.note: Seat of the Moravian Brethren (Brüdergemeine) in the Upper Lusatia.

decisions.label: Kauern
decisions.note: One of the "greizer Orte" (Reuss ä. L.).

decisions.label: Kleinfriesa
decisions.note: Part of the Gemeinde Lobenstein.

decisions.label: Heberndorf
decisions.note: Village at the Schwarzburg-Reuss border (Heineberg).

decisions.label: Danzig
decisions.note: Mentioned in a children's rhyme.

decisions.label: Heringen
decisions.note: In a list of possessions of the Vögte of Plauen (Herrschaft Heringen); identification not verified.

decisions.label: Kirchberg
decisions.note: Several hills of this name (e.g. at Lobenstein, Dorna, Köstritz); also surname/place Kirchberg in single mentions.

decisions.label: Hermannsdorf
decisions.note: Two Wüstungen of this name: near Lichtenau (Gera district, p. 519) and near Zollgrün (p. 695).

decisions.label: Frankenau
decisions.note: Village on the Altenburg side of the border (Staatsvertrag of 25 Sept. 1847).

decisions.label: Dornholz
decisions.note: Group of 10 houses near the Hof road, formerly and still in the vernacular "Dornbusch".

decisions.label: Klettigsgrund
decisions.note: Group of 14 houses in the Sormitzgrund (1683 Klettig, later Klettigshammer), Gemeinde Heinersdorf.

decisions.label: Aga
decisions.note: Collective name for Großaga and Kleinaga (Aga region near Köstritz).

decisions.label: Heukewalde
decisions.note: Parish village near Hermsdorf (Gera district) on the Altenburg side.

decisions.label: Desse
decisions.note: Deserted village mostly in the Kraftsdorf, partly Harpersdorf Flur (1184 Deginstete).

decisions.label: Görlitz (Hühnerbach)
decisions.note: Brook (Hühnerbach) near Löhma/Schleiz; a few mentions concern the town Görlitz or are slips for Göritz.

decisions.label: Hartenstein
decisions.note: Hartenstein in the Erzgebirge (Grafschaft Hartenstein of the Burggrafen of Meißen and Plauen).

decisions.label: Heinrichsstadt
decisions.note: New town quarter of Schleiz laid out on princely ground with the new residence palace.

decisions.label: Vollersdorf
decisions.note: Probably the Wüstung Vollersdorf (p. 448) of the Gera district; Burgmannengut of Osterstein.

decisions.label: Karolinengrün
decisions.note: Originally Erdmuthengrün; favourite residence of the Reuss-Ebersdorf counts.

decisions.label: Hayn
decisions.note: Rittergut Hayn on the Altenburg side (family of Brandenstein), near Gera; single mention is the Lobenstein suburb Hayn.

decisions.label: Heinrichsthal
decisions.note: Steel hammer (Wetter- or Brückenhammer) in the Wetteragrund, Gemeinde Gräfenwarth (1766).

decisions.label: Eichenstein
decisions.note: Rittergut near Blankenstein, in a list of manors of the Lobenstein area; no article in Brückner's Ortskunde.

decisions.label: Baireuth
decisions.note: Town and (Brandenburg-)Bayreuth territory, see also Brandenburg-Baireuth.

decisions.label: Hennemannsreuth
decisions.note: Single house below Saalhof (Gemeinde Saaldorf), 13 inhabitants.

decisions.label: Altenebersdorf
decisions.note: Wüstung in the Schönbrunn Flur (pp. 738, 741, 742).

decisions.label: Fürstenthum Reuß älterer Linie
decisions.note: Neighbouring principality (Greiz).

decisions.label: Christiansglück
decisions.note: Former alum and vitriol works ("Silberknie", "Vitriolwerk") below the Rödelshammer, Gemeinde Saaldorf.

decisions.label: Elsterthal
decisions.note: Valley of the Weiße Elster in the Landrathsbezirk Gera.

decisions.label: Heinrichshütte
decisions.note: Ironworks below Solmsgrün (founded 1729 as Mangolds Drahthammer), Gemeinde Wurzbach.

decisions.label: Horla
decisions.note: Secluded house in the Gemeinde Ullersreuth, also called Orlau.

decisions.label: Böhmsdorf
decisions.note: Collective name for Oberböhmsdorf (p. 594) and Niederböhmsdorf (p. 649).

decisions.label: Gleißberg
decisions.note: Burg Gleißberg near Jena, in a list of possessions of the Vögte of Plauen.

decisions.label: Gau Gera
decisions.note: Early medieval district around Gera (Geraha, Gerahaga).

decisions.label: Froschweide
decisions.note: Eastern part of the double settlement Kleinaga/Froschweide (two Gemeinden).

decisions.label: Kühdorf
decisions.note: Village in the Weimar Amtsbezirk Weida, formerly Reuss.

decisions.label: Hainsberg
decisions.note: Village in the Weimar Amtsbezirk Weida, formerly Reuss.

decisions.label: Eichert (Eichhart)
decisions.note: Forest at Saalburg with a Vorwerk (Gemeinde Kulm).

decisions.label: Kämmera
decisions.note: Deserted since before 1533, south of Tanna at the source of the Wettera.

decisions.label: Bärwinkel
decisions.note: Single house at the Wegnersbach, Gemeinde Kießling.

decisions.label: Herrschaft Lobenstein
decisions.note: Former lordship of Lobenstein; later Landestheil Lobenstein-Ebersdorf.

decisions.label: Eibig
decisions.note: Field name in the Heinersdorf Flur (list of Hauptflurstücke).

decisions.label: Absang
decisions.note: Seven scattered single houses, Gemeinde Kießling; the register prints "Abfang" (long s misread).

decisions.label: Gottmannsgrün
decisions.note: Gemeinde mentioned in the Hirschberg article (foundations for the town and the Gemeinde Gottmannsgrün); no article of its own in the Ortskunde.

decisions.label: Holzland
decisions.note: Region in the Unterland, extending from Kraftsdorf and Harpersdorf over Waltersdorf and Schöna.

decisions.label: Förthen
decisions.note: Filial village near Kirschkau (with Läwitz); no article of its own in the Ortskunde.

decisions.label: Hungriger Wolf
decisions.note: Inn (single house) in the Gemeinde Langenwetzendorf.

decisions.label: Ebersberg
decisions.note: Three farms, Gemeinde Willersdorf; formerly parished to Tanna.

decisions.label: Hohenleuben-Pöllwitz
decisions.note: Exclave of the principality around Hohenleuben and Pöllwitz.

decisions.label: Grund
decisions.note: Grund am Harz, named for a geological comparison.

decisions.label: Amt Burgk
decisions.note: The Greiz (Reuss ä. L.) Amt Burgk on the Saale ("greizer Amt Burg").

decisions.label: Crispendorf
decisions.note: In the Amt Burgk (Reuss ä. L.).

decisions.label: Dörflas
decisions.note: In the Amt Burgk (Reuss ä. L.), at the Saale.

decisions.label: Höfle
decisions.note: Former settlement on the Höflesbach (name of the brook).

decisions.label: Bärenthal
decisions.note: Field/valley name quoted among place names derived from bears (also Berthel); not a specific village.

decisions.label: Hart
decisions.note: Forest at Langenwetzendorf where the last bears were shot about 1730.

decisions.label: Kleina
decisions.note: Village in the Neustadt (Orla) district of Saxe-Weimar; compared with Gleina in a name parallel.

decisions.label: Dossau
decisions.note: Occurs only in a legend ("Hainherr von Dossau"); identification unknown.

decisions.label: Hohenforst
decisions.note: Place near Schneeberg with the mine Fürstenberg.

decisions.label: Eckernförde
decisions.note: Naval action of 5 April 1849 (decoration).

decisions.label: Ilm
decisions.note: Village in the upper Sormitz area (with Burglemnitz, Gleima, Weitisberga); outside the principality; not the river Ilm.

decisions.reason: court district label (Einzelgericht Gera I) in a judicial statistics table
court district label (Einzelgericht Gera II) in a judicial statistics table

decisions.label: Graba
decisions.note: Estate of the Kloster Volkenroda near Graba, in the Saalfeld area.

decisions.label: Frauenstein
decisions.note: In a list of Bohemian/Egerland possessions of the Vögte of Plauen; identification not verified (not Frauenstein in the Erzgebirge by assumption).

decisions.label: Jagow
decisions.note: Provostry Jagow (Uckermark); a Reuss prince became provost there.

decisions.label: Aussig
decisions.note: Battle of Aussig 1426.

decisions.label: Gräslitz
decisions.note: Schloss Gräslitz in Bohemia.

decisions.label: Arnshaugk
decisions.note: Burg Arnshaugk near Neustadt an der Orla; treaty of 1428.

decisions.label: Gera-Schleiz-Lobenstein
decisions.note: Composite title of the Lord of the three Reuss lordships Gera, Schleiz and Lobenstein.

decisions.label: von Erlichshausen
decisions.note: Noble family name used in a genealogical remark; not a place.

decisions.label: Guteborn
decisions.note: Estate/lordship of the Gräfin von Hoym in the Lausitz.

decisions.reason: part of a noble house name (Birkenfeld-Gelnhausen) in a genealogical table, not a place reference

decisions.label: Johannisplatz
decisions.note: Square in Gera (Baderthor).

decisions.label: Betzdorf
decisions.note: Wüstung (1333 Beczelingesdorf) in the Hirschfeld area; register spelling Betzdorf.

decisions.label: Bauska
decisions.note: Gemeinde united with Schwaara (double name Schwaara-Bauska), Landrathsbezirk Gera.

decisions.label: Bassinplatz
decisions.note: Square in Schleiz.

decisions.label: Kaltenhof
decisions.note: Part of the Gemeinde Oschitz (with Oberoschitz and two mills).

decisions.label: Igelsdorf
decisions.note: Also Wüstenigelsdorf; deserted, SE of Pahren.

decisions.label: Hermannsgrün
decisions.note: Parish mentioned in the Koskau article (Reformation period); not in the principality.

decisions.label: Kirchwiesen
decisions.note: Field name in the Heinersdorf Flur.

decisions.label: Joachimsmühle
decisions.note: Grist, oil and saw mill north of the Lückenmühle ("Gochensmühle"), at the border of the Streitwald and Schwarzburg territory.

decisions.label: Haßlersberg
decisions.note: Group of 16 houses in the Gemeinde Wurzbach.

decisions.label: Ansbach
decisions.note: Consistory of Ansbach (Brandenburg-Ansbach).

decisions.label: Galenberg
decisions.note: Princely crown estate at Lobenstein (Galenberg, Galgenvorwerk).

decisions.label: Bayerisches Voigtland
decisions.note: The Bavarian part of the Vogtland (Upper Saale district).

decisions.label: Algier
decisions.note: In the saying "Algier, Tunis und Tripolis".

decisions.label: Altgernsdorf
decisions.note: Village in Reuss ä. L. at the axis of the Oberland.

decisions.label: Falker Grund
decisions.note: Valley (Grund) at Falke between the Wipse and the Falke area.

decisions.label: Bramthal
decisions.note: Valley of the Bramthal (Brambach) in the Gera district.

decisions.label: Käseschenke
decisions.note: Highest inhabited place in the Unterland (Gemeinde Kaltenborn).

decisions.label: Alter Markt
decisions.note: Old market square in Gera (also Schleiz).

decisions.label: Henkersfleck
decisions.note: Hill in the Lobenstein area (list of heights).

decisions.label: Kreuztanne
decisions.note: Landmark/forest spot near Hornsgrün.

decisions.label: Franzensberg
decisions.note: Slate quarries at the Franzensberg.

decisions.label: Chursdorf
decisions.note: Weimar territory (weimarisches Chursdorf) at Plothen.

decisions.reason: illustrative name form in a discussion of the dialect suffix -au/-á (Dorsá, Höferá, Löhlá, Kämmerá ...), not a place reference

decisions.label: Altenbeuthen
decisions.note: Village at the Otterbach/Autrabach mouth (Schwarzburg territory).

decisions.label: Hockerode
decisions.note: Village where the Sormitz joins the Loquitz.

decisions.label: Grünau
decisions.note: Village on the Sormitz above the Weitisberga mill; no article in the Ortskunde.

decisions.label: Amt Weida
decisions.note: Weimar Amt Weida.

decisions.reason: place names quoted as etymological parallels (Bramberg, Bramstedt, Bramwald), no specific place

decisions.label: Baltenheim
decisions.note: Place on the Sprese/Sprotte brook in the Altenburg country.

decisions.label: Dessegrund
decisions.note: Valley at Desse near Kraftsdorf (Martinsquelle, Währigsborn).

decisions.label: Herrengasse
decisions.note: Street in Hohenleuben (well of 40 ft).

decisions.label: Hainteichen
decisions.note: Ponds near Schleiz (Gentiana verna).

decisions.reason: generic local name cited as an example of oak place names (Eichberg, Buchberg), no specific place

decisions.label: Küchengarten
decisions.note: Garden area at Gera (Osterstein).

decisions.reason: generic plural field name (so-called Hopfenberge) cited as evidence for former hop growing, no specific place

decisions.label: Hainberg
decisions.note: Hill at the Osterstein, Gera (Hainberg, Hain, Osterstein).

decisions.label: Heinrichstein
decisions.note: Natural landmark near Ebersdorf (register: Heinrichsstein, p. 727).

decisions.label: Kerbe
decisions.note: Warm valley slope near Gera.

decisions.reason: table row label (total for the Gera district), not a place

decisions.label: Hannover
decisions.note: Appears in statistical tables as the state (Kingdom of Hanover).

decisions.label: Bezirk Gera
decisions.note: One of the three Bezirke of the principality.

decisions.label: Bezirk Schleiz
decisions.note: One of the three Bezirke of the principality (Wisentaland).

decisions.label: Bezirk Lobenstein-Ebersdorf
decisions.note: One of the three Bezirke of the principality; abbreviated Lobenst.-Ebersd.

decisions.label: Ciba
decisions.note: Field name in the Gemeinde Göritz (Slavic/Bohemian place name transferred to a local field).

decisions.label: Gruschitz
decisions.note: Field name in Burkersdorf (cf. Bohemian place name).

decisions.label: Dels
decisions.note: Field name in Dettersdorf (cf. Dels).

decisions.label: Gröben
decisions.note: Field name in Pöritzsch (cf. place-name parallels).

decisions.label: Döhlen
decisions.note: "döhlener Brunnen": quarter/hamlet in the Hohenleuben Gemeinde; named in a table of Slavic roots (dele "Tiefe").

decisions.label: Beulwitz
decisions.note: Place name in the table of Slavic roots (bjel); village near Saalfeld.

decisions.label: Elsch
decisions.note: Name in the table of Slavic roots (ülsa "Erle"); not identified.

decisions.label: Kattenstein
decisions.note: Name in the table of Slavic roots (kot "Katze"); not identified.

decisions.label: Hecksburg
decisions.note: Church portals at Wechselburg and Hecksburg compared with Reuss church sculpture.

decisions.label: Kayla
decisions.note: Place at the dialect boundary of the Tanna area ("Nibel/Nabel"); variant Kaila.

decisions.label: Hochland
decisions.note: Dialect region, the upper Hochland of the Oberland.

decisions.label: Brambach
decisions.note: Vogtland place in a rhyme listing Vogtland breweries.

decisions.label: Joduschiz
decisions.note: Occurs only in a legend; identification unknown.

decisions.label: Köpsen
decisions.note: Village near Trebnitz/Speutewitz, outside the principality.

decisions.label: Cossen-Forst
decisions.note: Forest district (Forst) in the list of forests; cf. Wüstung Cosse.

decisions.label: Dürrhof
decisions.note: Estate with a Schäferei (register: Dürrhof, dürrer Hof) in the Gemeinde Oberböhmsdorf; not Dürrenhof in Franconia.

decisions.label: Geestemünde
decisions.note: Emigration port (declarations).

decisions.label: Bremerhaven
decisions.note: Emigration port (declarations).

decisions.label: Boitersreuth
decisions.note: Destination in emigration declarations; not identified.

decisions.label: Herbesthal
decisions.note: Border station (Prussia/Belgium) in emigration declarations.

decisions.label: Harburg
decisions.note: Harburg on the Elbe; destination in emigration declarations.

decisions.label: Eichicht
decisions.note: Terminus of the Gera-Eichicht railway (treaty of 4 December 1867).

decisions.reason: part of the ruler's title ("souveräner Fürst Reuß j. L."), not a place reference

decisions.label: Gräfenwarth-Kulm
decisions.note: Combined unit of Gräfenwarth and Kulm (near Saalburg) in an administrative table.

decisions.label: Dohna
decisions.note: Town in Saxony (pastor at Dohna).

decisions.label: Castell
decisions.note: "Gräfin von Castell": noble family (Counts of Castell, Franconia), not a place reference.

decisions.label: Corvey
decisions.note: "Mönche von Corvey" (mission to the Sorbs).

decisions.label: Halberstadt
decisions.note: Margraviate/diocese Halberstadt (among the Thuringian margraviates).

decisions.label: Eckartsberga
decisions.note: Town and Kreis Eckartsberga (Prussian province of Saxony).

decisions.label: Buscha
decisions.note: Estate of the Cronschwitz endowment near Altenburg.

decisions.label: Gimmel
decisions.note: Estate of the Cronschwitz endowment near Altenburg.

decisions.label: Igelsberg
decisions.note: Estate of the Cronschwitz endowment near Altenburg.

decisions.label: von Heldrungen
decisions.note: "Berchta (v. Heldrungen?)": noble family in a genealogical table, not a place reference.

decisions.label: von Colditz
decisions.note: "N. (v. Colditz?)": noble family in a genealogical table, not a place reference.

decisions.label: Grafen von Eberstein
decisions.note: "aus dem gräfl. Hause Eberstein": noble house, not a place reference.

decisions.label: Engelsburg
decisions.note: Bohemian possession in a list of the Vögte of Plauen.
